subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI chat support remote Markdown images, and if yes should that be direct browser http(s) loading or an explicit/proxied opt-in media path?
rationale: Current shipped code and tests intentionally block the requested behavior for security/privacy reasons, so automation should not reverse that policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep safe default and design an explicit media path
options.body: Leave remote Markdown images flattened by default and pursue inline media through a capability-gated, proxied, allowlisted, or opt-in design that names the browser-fetch risk.

options.title: Allow direct remote Markdown images
options.body: Accept that model-provided markdown can cause browser requests to arbitrary image hosts and update the renderer, CSP, tests, and docs accordingly.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decide that arbitrary remote Markdown images should remain unsupported and point users to managed media attachments or future inline-widget work instead.

recommendation.title: Keep safe default and design an explicit media path
recommendation.body: Leave remote Markdown images flattened by default and pursue inline media through a capability-gated, proxied, allowlisted, or opt-in design that names the browser-fetch risk.

likelyOwner.reason: The current related inline web chat widgets PR and maintainer label history make steipete the best available product-direction routing candidate from the inspected owners.
